DOR.CRE.REC.No.04/09.27.000/2026-27

April 01, 2026

All Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks

Madam / Dear Sir,

Master Circular - Guarantees, Co-Acceptances & Letters of Credit - UCBs

This Master Circular consolidates instructions to Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks on guarantees, co-acceptances and letters of credit issued up to March 31, 2026. Banks should not issue guarantees on behalf of customers who do not enjoy credit facilities with them.

(A. Kumar)
Chief General Manager
